description: List all XRPL domains owned by a wallet address. Use when the user asks "what domains do I own?", "show me my domains", or wants to see another wallet's holdings. Returns each domain with its TLD, length, primary flag, subname flag, and quick-action URLs. (nftoken_id, image, and mint time are not included here — use get_domain_profile for one domain.) Requires an XRPL r... address.

address.description: XRPL r... address whose domains to list.

sort.description: Sort order. "recent" keeps the backend order.

name: get_portfolio
